W.A. Sheaffer Pen Co.
Gold Plated and Resin Fountain Pen
Mid-Century Modern, Circa 1940s-1950s
This vintage W.A. Sheaffer fountain pen features a classic burgundy resin body paired with a gold-plated metal cap decorated with a wavy incised line pattern. The pen is equipped with the distinctive 14k gold "Triumph" conical wraparound nib, a hallmark of Sheaffer's mid-century premium writing instruments. The barrel is clearly stamped with the manufacturer's hallmark and location of Fort Madison, Iowa, reflecting the craftsmanship of the American golden age of fountain pens.
14k gold conical Triumph-style nib, stamped "SHEAFFER'S 14K MADE IN U.S.A."
Gold-plated cap with polished finish and horizontal wavy line engraving
Burgundy resin barrel and grip section with stamped manufacturer markings
Provided Dimensions: 3" L x 1" W x 5" H
Condition:
The pen has not been tested for functionality. Visually, the piece is in good vintage condition with age-appropriate surface wear. The gold-plated cap shows minor micro-scratching but no major dents or visible brassing. The 14k gold nib appears straight and intact. The burgundy barrel retains a good luster with readable factory imprints. Internal filling mechanism is present but its operational status is unknown.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Zippo Pipe Lighters
Lot of 2 Lighters, Black Matte and Brushed Chrome
Made in USA, 2012 and 2014
This lot features two authentic Zippo pipe lighters, specifically designed for pipe smokers with a specialized chimney insert that allows the flame to be drawn directly into the pipe bowl without damaging it. Both lighters are marked with a pipe silhouette on the front corner and were manufactured in Bradford, Pennsylvania. These lighters are highly functional collectibles known for their durability and windproof design.
Items Included:
Black Matte Zippo Pipe Lighter - Date code K 12 (November 2012), featuring a white pipe graphic and specialized chimney insert.
Brushed Chrome Zippo Pipe Lighter - Date code J 14 (October 2014), featuring a black pipe graphic and specialized chimney insert.
Dimensions: Approximately 1.5 inches length, 1 inch width, 2.5 inches height per lighter.
Condition:
Both lighters show signs of previous use including internal carbon buildup and soot in the chimneys. The black matte finish has light surface scuffing and minor wear along the edges. The brushed chrome finish shows typical pocket wear with fine hairline scratches. Hinges are secure and snap shut. Wicks are present but used; flint and fuel status has not been tested.
